checks.detail: 19 focused tests pass on the locked runtime: 17 module tests cover canonical binding payload/sha stability and drift, matching and drifted providers, missing identity fields, non-invokable providers, invalid profile/pricing/retry, missing limits, non-identity providers, composed gates, construct_provider acceptance/rejection, and spawn-identity drift; 2 controller tests cover the new binding gate before construction and the unchanged frozen-member invocation path.

The T10 diff touches exactly the four owned files: campaign_controller.py (imports plus the binding gate replacement and spawn re-verification), tests/test_control_plane_campaign_controller.py (one new test), and the two new files (binding module and its test module); no unrelated module, dependency, or forbidden path changed.

The new module performs no I/O, no subprocesses, and no provider SDK imports; the controller binding gate raises before any provider executor construction and before any usage write, and the new controller test asserts zero persisted attempts after rejection.

A 1116-test regression run passes on the locked runtime, including the full control-plane suite (with the complete campaign_controller module and the new binding module), automation resilience, capital projection, CLI entry guards, legacy harness quarantine, promotion provenance, and AG2 orchestration/tool-loop/memory/model/file-security tests.
Spec and quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN.
